class.name: NetwAdmissionConfig
class.brief_description: Settings for a session's admission handler.

method.name: accept
method.description: Adds [param provider] to the accounts a joining player proves, in preference order. Accept the same providers in the same order on every peer. A config with no provider sends no challenge.

method.name: timeout
method.description: Gives every join [param seconds] to be admitted, the server's own included. A client's time counts from connecting to the server, and the server tells the client this deadline, so only the server's value counts. A join still waiting when it passes is refused with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_TIMEOUT]. Without it, [member NetwMultiplayer.auth_timeout] is the deadline.
